messages:
jon (AE): Heads-up — BlueWave just pushed an amendment asking for contract-level guarantees: 99.99% uptime for hosted inference + P99 text-gen latency <120ms for their critical routes. They want this in the SOW. Can we commit?

maria (PM): Thanks for flagging. Need clarity on scope: is this for all models/paths or a specific production route? Also is BlueWave expecting single-region SLA or multi-region?

jon (AE): It's specifically for the "checkout-personalization" route using rdx-3-small and only hosted API. They want single-region (us-east) for now, with an option to opt into multi-region later. They also want 24/7 faster support (phone escalation).

alex (Eng): Quick reality check — 99.99% for hosted single-tenant route at low latency is possible but expensive. We need reserved capacity (Dedicated) or aggressive warm pools + autoscale. For generic shared hosted infra, 99.9% is more realistic.

sam (CSE): We should map this to a support tier. Phone escalation + 15m initial response = Enterprise SLA. Also call out exclusions (DDOS, customer network).

maria (PM): Proposal: offer two productized options to sales: A) Hosted Premium: 99.9% uptime, P99 <200ms, 24/7 ticket+email, 2hr SLA for sev1 — lower price. B) Dedicated Enterprise: reserved capacity for that route, 99.99% uptime, P99 <120ms, phone + pager escalation, confirmed capacity commit. Sales can upsell B. Thoughts?

jon (AE): That's workable. BlueWave is asking for the tighter one; will they accept Dedicated commitment? They're pushing back on reserved cost.

alex (Eng): If we go Dedicated Enterprise, engineering needs explicit rollout + acceptance criteria:
- Reserved GPU pool sized for peak QPS + 2x headroom
- Autoscaling test harness and chaos tests (node kill, region failover)
- Monitoring: synthetic checks per route every 30s, real-time SLO dashboard
- Fallback policy: auto-route to fallback model variant on degradation
- Runbook + oncall escalation mapping in PD

sam (CSE): Add support playbook: 15m ack -> 1hr remediation update -> 4hr workaround or rollback. Escalation path: CSE -> Eng-oncall -> Eng-Platform -> Customer Success -> Exec if >24h unresolved.

maria (PM): Good list. For product backlog we need a small spec doc and launch criteria. I'll draft the spec but need inputs from eng and SRE: perf targets, test scenarios, and cost estimate for reserved capacity.

alex (Eng): I'll drop a perf matrix and a rough cost calc today. Also: we must add a config flag per-customer to pin regional routing + capacity. That requires a short infra change. Estimate: 3 wks eng + 2 wks SRE validation.

jon (AE): BlueWave timeline: wants to sign by EOM next month. Can we accelerate?

maria (PM): If we prioritize as P0 and scope the first delivery to a single route and single region, maybe. Need commitment from eng to hit timeline.

alex (Eng): If we cut scope to single route + no cross-region failover initially, could do an MVP in 3 weeks (fast-track) but that means lower SLO testing. Full 99.99 confidence needs the 5wk plan above.

sam (CSE): Risk note: if we promise 99.99 without full chaos testing we expose contract risk. Recommend contractual ramp: start with 99.9 for first 30 days post-launch, then upgrade to 99.99 after validation window. That should placate customer and buy us time.

jon (AE): BlueWave might accept ramp approach if we give a price credit for initial period. I'll negotiate that.

maria (PM): Action items:
- jon: negotiate ramp + credit with BlueWave, confirm acceptance.
- alex: perf matrix, capacity calc, infra flag estimate (due EOD).
- sam: draft support runbook + escalation timeline, outline PSL/response SLA text for contract.
- maria: create product ticket and acceptance criteria, include launch checklist.

oncall-bot: Created ticket PROD-4827 "BlueWave enterprise routing & SLA intake" assigned to product-team, priority P0. Link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/PROD-4827

maria (PM): I'll create the product spec in the ticket and tag eng-sre + eng-platform. If we agree on ramp and pricing, we'll route this through legal for SOW language.

jon (AE): Thanks — I'll set expectation with BlueWave and get back with their response. :thumbsup:

alex (Eng): FYI we'll need a quick design review. I'll ping eng-platform and schedule a 30m review once I upload the perf matrix.

sam (CSE): I'll attach the escalation matrix and sample support terms to the ticket.

jon (AE): Closing loop — BlueWave rep wants phone call tomorrow at 10am. Can maria + alex join?

maria (PM): I can. Alex?

alex (Eng): I can do 10am. See you then. :+1:

oncall-bot: Reminder set for meeting: 2026-04-05 10:00 US/Eastern.
